# LuaSPortSensor:writeParameter

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Write a parameter to the S.Port Sensor.

```lua
local result = sensor:writeParameter(parameter, value)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `parameter` | integer | yes |  |
| `value` | integer | yes |  |

## Returns

result (boolean)
